# Production Scheduling

Curated by Skill Harbor: codified production-scheduling expertise from schedulers with 15+ years in discrete and batch manufacturing, framed as a senior-scheduler persona. Covers the fundamentals that MRP gets wrong (finite vs. infinite capacity, backward scheduling as the default), the Theory of Constraints with drum-buffer-rope (identify the true constraint by utilization ratio, protect it with time buffers monitored in green/yellow/red zones, subordinate every other decision to keeping the drum fed), changeover optimization (SMED phases from classifying setups to poka-yoke, sequence-dependent setup matrices, campaign vs. mixed-model economics), and bottleneck management (distinguishing true constraints from WIP pile-ups, detecting shifting bottlenecks by shift and product mix). Includes disruption response playbooks (machine breakdowns, material shortages, quality holds, absenteeism) with a re-sequencing framework and a 30-minute communication rule, dispatching rules (EDD, SPT, setup-aware EDD), OEE calculation with world-class targets, ERP/MES interaction patterns (SAP PP, Oracle, work order flow, plan adherence above 90%), escalation triggers, and per-shift KPIs. By @affaan-m, listed here with credit to its creator. From the affaan-m/ECC repository (the skill declares Apache-2.0).
